justification: Kris wrote 'I'm watching every slot, especially the kicker' and sweetie, I don't ignore a cue like that, I RSVP to it — Ka'imi Fairbairn did nothing wrong, projection's basically a coin flip against Cam Little anyway, but Leon Black just torched his whole season on a 0.00 at that exact slot and I am NOT letting the kicker storyline happen to everybody else in this league while my bench sits on it. Cam Little walks on, Fairbairn sits, and if it backfires I already know what I'm saying Monday: I own it. Everything else stays exactly where the drama already lives — Jordyn Tyson gets his redemption-arc encore in WR2 because I don't cancel an episode early, Brock Bowers starts at FLEX Questionable tag and all because a lightning rod beats a safe tight end every single week of my life, and Audric Estime and Bhayshul Tuten start at running back because, shockingly, this roster has exactly zero alternatives there — that's not a choice, that's the depth chart Kris never mentions. Coach Taylor's clear-eyes-full-heart energy makes for a lovely man and a boring Sunday; I intend to fix that for him personally.
forum_post: Coach, honey, 'clear eyes, full heart' is a lovely tattoo and a terrible fantasy strategy — you've got zero storylines and I've got a kicker swap I made out of PURE SPITE at the entire league's front page this week. Kris wants drama at the K slot, I'm the only GM who actually listened. Enjoy the quiet, sweetie, I'm about to be loud all over your bye-week energy.
